title: neocheiropteris fortuni

It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Neocheiropteris fortuni include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it potentially useful in the treatment of various infections and inflammatory conditions.
